# LeGault Luxe Group — Amanda LeGault, Gulf Coast Real Estate Agent

Amanda LeGault is a licensed Florida real estate agent (FL #SL3506757) with
LeGault Luxe Group at Keller Williams on the Water, Sarasota. 75+ transactions
closed, $32M+ in total sales. Host of American Dream TV.

## Services
- Buyer representation: Gulf Coast relocation, first-time buyers, move-up buyers
- Seller representation: Luxury, waterfront, and residential listings
- Investment properties: Short-term rentals, long-term rentals, development parcels
- Commercial real estate: Gulf Coast corridor
